title: VibeMint
tagline: A fun social media platform where you can make creative posts, mint and sell them if you want
description: A fun social media platform where you can make creative posts, mint and sell them if you want to. You can signup/login via google, coinbase, metamask or your wallet, you get to set your bio, connect to your wallet via privy, you can create posts, follow people, like and comment on there posts, all using prisma ORM, however despite our best efforts we couldnt integrate the minting functionality which we earlier planned to do using coinbase AgentKit
how_its_made: We tried to build a social media platform using Nextjs frame work and planned to mint NFTs using coinbase Agentkit but unfortunately couldnt integrate it as planned, however our social media is completely functional you can create an account, make posts, connect your wallet via privy, like, comment and all other features just like any social media platform. The branch named "final_branch" is the one which contains final code.
